Veinminer Client is including a version of `fabric-permissions-api` that is incompatible with your Minecraft version.

Either
1) Uninstall Veinminer Client
2) or install [fabric-permissions-api](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-permissions-api/versions) for your Minecraft Version to override the broken version
